item.title: Welcome to Hugo
item.description: Welcome to our new Hugo-powered blog! This is a demonstration of how the iA4 WordPress theme has been successfully converted to a static Hugo site. Hugo is one of the most popular open-source static site generators. With its amazing speed and flexibility, Hugo makes building websites fun again. Features of This Site This converted site includes several key features: Math Support: We’ve integrated KaTeX for beautiful mathematical expressions like $E = mc^2$ and display equations: $$\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} e^{-x^2} dx = \sqrt{\pi}$$
